thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic high-saturation HDR street photograph, one single natural scene, eye-level, no split screen, strong chiaroscuro with deep crushed shadows. Two unbranded 1990s Korean confectionery buildings stand side by side on the same street. The left one is shut down under a hot burning orange sunset sky: its rolling steel shutter pulled down and deeply scratched, rusted and dented, the gate chained, an old blank signboard above it with peeling paint and scratched weathered metal, long black shadows across the pavement. The right one, the same size, is running at night-like contrast under cold electric blue floodlights: workers loading boxes of biscuits onto a delivery truck, steam rising from a vent, blue light spilling from the windows. No logos, no signs with letters, no text anywhere. Keep the bottom 35-40% simple and darker for text. Gritty high-clarity HDR photo, heavy micro-contrast and sharpening, visible film grain and fine noise, crisp detailed textures on metal, glass and water, dust particles and small debris in the air, dramatic volumetric clouds, strong chiaroscuro lighting with deep crushed shadows, split color grading of cold electric blue versus hot burning orange, scratched and weathered metal textures, slightly over-processed look.

thumbnails.prompt_en: Photorealistic cinematic HDR interior, one single scene, no split screen, strong chiaroscuro with deep crushed shadows. Through the large glass window behind it, a snack production line runs at full speed under cold electric blue industrial lights, biscuits streaming along scratched steel conveyors, workers in white caps. The orange-lit dead desk against the blue-lit working factory floor is the whole story. No logos, no readable text. Keep the bottom 35-40% simple and darker for text.
